hook: 75 saal baad Nani ne wo chabi nikaali...
hook_text: 2 30 AM par Nani ne kya khulwaya?
feedback: Great pacing and atmospheric tension. The cold-open hook works well, and the twist lands with high emotional resonance. To sharpen it further: ensure Rehan's reaction in cut 11 shows a clearer shift from fear to heartbreak, and make sure the transition from the old Nani to the 1947 mother spirit in the final images feels completely smooth visually. REPEATS: an image is reused too often or twice in a row; use new inserts (hands, eyes, lantern, a clue) instead.
lines: 75 saal baad Nani ne wo chabi nikaali...
Par tehakana khulte hi sach samne aa gaya.
Aadhi raat ko Rehan Bhopal ki purani haveli me packing kar raha tha.
80 saal ki Nani chupchap uske sath chal rahi thin.
Tabhi Nani ne ek zang-laga purana taala aur chabi di.
Betu, tehakana khol de... maine apna wada poora kiya.
1947 ke baad se ye darwaza kabhi nahi khula tha.
Andar bas ek khali brass crib tha... aur purana akhbar.
Bachi ko bachakar, ma khud isi kamre me dam tod chuki thi!
Rehan ne peeche dekha... corridor bilkul khali tha!
Wo Nani nahi, unki ma ki rooh thi... jo bachi ke liye ruki thi.
Kisi purani haveli me aadhi raat ko chabi mile, toh taala mat kholna.
